typography.primary_font_usage: Bible verses, daily quotes, large emotional headings. Offers a classic, respectful, and emotional feel.
typography.secondary_font_usage: App UI, body text, buttons, history list. Provides a soft, readable, modern contrast to the serif.

home_input.description: A journal-like prominent text area where users type their struggle. Not a standard input box. It should feel like a safe, blank page.
home_input.styles: bg-[#F4F1EA] rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 min-h-[200px] text-lg text-[#2D3A30] placeholder-[#717C73] focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#A88D7D]/50 border-none

submit_button.description: Organic, soft-pill button to submit the prayer/problem.
submit_button.styles: bg-[#2D3A30] text-[#FAF9F6] rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-medium text-base hover:bg-[#4A6150] transition-colors shadow-sm

verse_display.description: Hero section for the matched verse. Massive top/bottom padding, center-aligned serif text.
verse_display.styles: font-['Cormorant_Garamond'] text-3xl sm:text-4xl leading-relaxed text-[#2D3A30] text-center mb-8

explanation_card.description: Empathetic explanation container sitting below the verse.
explanation_card.styles: bg-white/60 backdrop-blur-md rounded-3xl p-6 text-base text-[#4A6150] leading-relaxed border border-[#2D3A30]/5

voice_player.description: Minimalist audio player. A floating pill or organic bottom sheet with play/pause and subtle progress indication.
voice_player.styles: fixed bottom-24 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-[#F4F1EA] rounded-full px-6 py-3 flex items-center gap-4 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(45,58,48,0.08)] border border-[#2D3A30]/5 backdrop-blur-xl

bottom_tab_nav.styles: fixed bottom-0 w-full h-20 bg-[#FAF9F6]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-[#2D3A30]/5 flex justify-around items-center px-6 pb-safe

micro_interactions.button_press: Scale down slightly (scale-95) with opacity reduction (opacity-90) using spring animation.
micro_interactions.page_transition: Slow crossfade (400ms ease-in-out) to mimic deep breaths, avoiding fast slide animations.
micro_interactions.voice_playing: Subtle pulsing ring or soft waveform around the play button using the primary accent color (#A88D7D).

icons.style: stroke-width 1.5, slightly rounded, colors matching text.secondary, active colors matching text.primary

home_background_overlay.description: Warm minimal abstract light to use as a very low-opacity (5%) background blend on the home screen to give it an ethereal warmth.

daily_verse_background.description: Golden calm ocean horizon. Perfect for the Daily Verse feature background, overlaid with a dark or light gradient scrim for text readability.

history_empty_state.description: Tranquil tree tops in fog. Use for empty states (e.g., 'No saved verses yet') to keep the vibe calm rather than displaying a generic blank screen.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is an Expo React Native application. Translate these Tailwind-like class strings into NativeWind classes or React Native StyleSheet objects appropriately.
Do NOT use typical default tech SaaS blues or purples. Stick strictly to the Organic & Earthy palette (Bone Whites, Warm Sands, Deep Olives).
Use the exact Google Fonts 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Outfit' via Expo Google Fonts.
Maintain generous padding across the app to reinforce the 'sanctuary' vibe. The UI must breathe.
For the Voice Player, do not build a complex timeline scrubber. Use a minimal play/pause action button with a subtle loading/playing state.
Always apply the defined `data-testid` properties to interactive elements for testing.
Ensure contrast is accessible. The primary text (#2D3A30) against the bone background (#FAF9F6) is highly readable. Do not lighten text too much.
